What this changes and why. Link the issue if there is one.

- [ ] `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo test` pass
- [ ] New behaviour has tests, and bug fixes have a test that failed before the fix
- [ ] README and skill are updated if anything user-facing changed
- [ ] Commits an AI tool wrote or shaped end with a `Co-Authored-By` trailer naming it (see [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/jacoobia/noted/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#using-ai-tools))
